description: vLLM serving on one GPU: throughput, TTFT/TPOT/ITL, scheduler queue vs batch, KV cache, SLO attainment. Based on vllm/examples/observability/prometheus_grafana/grafana.json.

panels.description: P50, P90, P95, and P99 TTFT latency in seconds. Includes queueing. Dashed line is the SLO (p95 <= 500 ms).
panels.title: Time To First Token Latency

panels.description: Per-request mean decode pace, (e2e - TTFT) / (output tokens - 1). Tracked apart from inter-token latency: TPOT is the pace a reader experiences, ITL exposes individual stalls. Dashed line is the SLO (p95 <= 50 ms).
panels.title: Time Per Output Token

panels.description: Number of tokens processed per second
panels.title: Token Throughput

panels.description: Completed requests per second. req/s answers capacity and autoscaling questions; tokens/s (left) answers GPU efficiency questions.
panels.title: Request Throughput

panels.description: Number of requests in RUNNING, WAITING, and SWAPPED state
panels.title: Scheduler State

panels.description: Percentage of used cache blocks by vLLM.
panels.title: Cache Utilization

panels.description: Requests evicted from the running batch because the KV cache ran out, then recomputed. Non-zero means KV, not compute, is the binding limit.
panels.title: Preemptions

panels.description: Share of requests inside the slo.md bounds over the rate window. Exact, not interpolated, because 0.5 s and 0.05 s are histogram bucket edges. Target is the dashed line at 95%.
panels.title: SLO Attainment

panels.description: End to end request latency measured in seconds.
panels.title: E2E Request Latency

panels.description: Number of finished requests by their finish reason: either an EOS token was generated or the max sequence length was reached.
panels.title: Finish Reason
